tools.name: hieronymus_decide
tools.description: Submit an evidence-grounded learned decision at the observed revision. Ordinary MCP never confers explicit-user authority.

tools.name: hieronymus_correct
tools.description: Submit a typed correction draft. Unverified user claims remain tentative or are rejected; authentic corrections use the separate console/host ingress.

tools.name: hieronymus_order_register
tools.description: Explicitly import a complete immutable order manifest from a local file or retained snapshot. The supplied hash covers all bytes.

tools.name: hieronymus_evidence_capture
tools.description: Explicitly import a full source/target UTF-8 snapshot or reuse immutable retained evidence. Selection uses absolute full-document byte offsets; expected_text is an assertion, never inline evidence.
